Unlike the null case which is handled by returning false (a graceful degradation), the XML entity case triggers an unchecked exception, indicating it is considered a programming error rather than a recoverable condition. The method's documentation does not mention this exception, further suggesting it is not intended to be caught explicitly by callers but rather to fail fast during development.
